note: A 50 ohm RTK031 coaxial GMSL2 cable with a FAKRA Z jack at each end (female to female, for a ZED Link card or ZED Box). Stated: outer jacket "3.3 ± 0.15 mm PVC" (diameter_mm 3.3); "Bending radius (static) 33 mm"; "Bending radius (loaded) 66 mm" (entered as the moving, dynamic radius: the datasheet does not define "loaded", an interpretation); "Flex life 10000" (the test radius and stroke are not stated); "data transfers of up to 6 Gbps" (stated_mbps 6000); "extended cable reach of up to 15 meters" (the M-F extension comes in 15 m); temperature -40 to +105 °C; DC to 6 GHz; return loss ≥ 20 dB up to 3 GHz. F-F lengths 0.3, 1.5, 5 and 10 m (CBL-320100 to CBL-320400). Not stated: mass, drag-chain or robotics rating.

price.what: the price depends on the length: 0.3 m (CBL-320100) 15.0, 1.5 m (CBL-320200) 25.0, 5 m (CBL-320300) 45.0, 10 m (CBL-320400) 60.0 USD
